cards.ex: Employees were encouraged to sound off about the proposed changes.
cards.exUz: Xodimlar taklif etilayotgan o'zgarishlar haqida o'z fikrlarini bildirishga undaldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizni baland ovozda, qat'iy bildirish.

cards.ex: Her pleas for help seemed to fall on deaf ears.
cards.exUz: Uning yordam so'rab iltijolari hech kimga ta'sir qilmadi.
cards.uzDef: Eshitsalar ham, hech kim e'tibor bermaslik, quloq solmaslik.

cards.ex: He's a squeaky wheel, always complaining, but he gets things done.
cards.exUz: U doimo shikoyat qiladigan bezovchi odam, lekin ishni bitiradi.
cards.uzDef: O'z muammolarini tinimsiz ta'kidlab, diqqatni jalb qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: I heard through the grapevine that she's leaving the company.
cards.exUz: Mish-mishlarga ko'ra, u kompaniyani tark etmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Norasmiy tarzda tarqaladigan xabar yoki mish-mish.

cards.ex: There was a ring of truth to what he said, despite my initial doubts.
cards.exUz: Dastlabki shubhalarimga qaramay, uning gaplarida rostlik alomatlari bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir rostga o'xshab tuyulishi, ishonchli bo'lishi.

cards.ex: They're working on the project on the quiet, so don't mention it.
cards.exUz: Ular loyiha ustida yashirincha ishlamoqda, shuning uchun bu haqda aytmang.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarga bildirmasdan, maxfiy ravishda qilinadigan ish.

cards.ex: The announcer had a booming voice that filled the stadium.
cards.exUz: E'lon qiluvchining baland ovozi stadionni to'ldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta, qattiq va jarangdor ovoz.

cards.ex: A piercing scream echoed through the dark alley.
cards.exUz: Qorong'i xiyobonda o'tkir qichqiriq yangradi.
cards.uzDef: Juda baland va keskin qichqiriq.

cards.ex: Please don't make a scene; let's discuss this calmly.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, janjal chiqarmang; keling, bu haqda xotirjam muhokama qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Baland ovozda bahslashib, odamlarning e'tiborini tortish.

cards.ex: The crowd erupted in a deafening roar when the goal was scored.
cards.exUz: Gol urilganda olomon quloqni qomatga keltiruvchi g'uv bilan portladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda baland va kuchli g'uvillash, qichqiriq.

cards.ex: His comments hit a sour note with many of the attendees.
cards.exUz: Uning izohlari ko'plab ishtirokchilarga yoqimsiz tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yoqimsiz yoki xato tuyulmoq.

cards.ex: A hushed whisper passed through the room as the speaker began.
cards.exUz: Notiq gap boshlaganda, xonada pichirlash eshitildi.
cards.uzDef: Juda sekin va ohista aytilgan gap.

cards.ex: As the manager, she gets to call the shots around here.
cards.exUz: Menejer sifatida, u bu yerda nima qilish kerakligini aytadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir nima qilish kerakligini aytish, boshqarish.

cards.ex: There was a buzz of excitement in the air before the concert started.
cards.exUz: Konsert boshlanishidan oldin havoda hayajonli shovqin bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiziqish yoki hayajon tufayli paydo bo'lgan shovqin.

cards.ex: A shot rang out, and the birds scattered.
cards.exUz: O'q ovozi eshitildi va qushlar tarqalib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Ovoz baland va aniq eshitilmoq.

cards.ex: An utter silence fell over the room when she announced her resignation.
cards.exUz: U iste'foga chiqishini e'lon qilganda, xonaga mutlaq sukut cho'kdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday ovoz bo'lmagan holat.

cards.ex: I wanted to argue, but I decided to hold my tongue.
cards.exUz: Men bahslashmoqchi edim, lekin tilimni tiyishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Gapirmaslik, jim turish.

cards.ex: The crowd fell silent as the speaker took the stage.
cards.exUz: Notiq sahnaga chiqqanda olomon jim bo'lib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Gapirmay qo'ymoq, sukut saqlamoq.

cards.ex: A low murmur of conversation filled the coffee shop.
cards.exUz: Qahvaxonani past shovqin egalladi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning sekin gaplashishi yoki ohista ovozlar.

cards.ex: I know on good authority that the deal is going to happen.
cards.exUz: Men ishonchli manbadan bilamanki, bitim amalga oshadi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchli manbadan olingan ma'lumot.

cards.ex: The child had a shrill voice that grated on my nerves.
cards.exUz: Bolaning ingichka ovozi mening asabimga tegdi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori va yoqimsiz eshitiladigan ovoz.

cards.ex: His raucous laugh echoed through the bar.
cards.exUz: Uning qo'pol kulgisi barda yangradi.
cards.uzDef: Baland va qo'pol kulgi.

cards.ex: There was a rumble of discontent among the workers about the new rules.
cards.exUz: Ishchilar orasida yangi qoidalar haqida norozilik g'uvillashi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Norozilikning sekin va past ovozi.

cards.ex: The city was a cacophony of noise: sirens, car horns, and construction.
cards.exUz: Shahar shovqin-suron edi: sirenlar, avtomobil signallari va qurilish.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimsiz, bir-biriga aralashgan ovozlar to'plami.

cards.ex: After the party, the sound of silence was almost unsettling.
cards.exUz: Partiyadan keyin sukut ovozi deyarli bezovta qilardi.
cards.uzDef: Odatda shovqin bo'ladigan joyda sukut hukm surishi.

cards.ex: He said he was unhappy, or words to that effect.
cards.exUz: U baxtsiz ekanligini aytdi, yoki shunga o'xshash gaplarni.
cards.uzDef: Aniq so'zlar emas, lekin shunga o'xshash ma'no beradigan gaplar.

cards.ex: A wave of sound erupted from the stadium as the team won.
cards.exUz: Jamoa g'alaba qozonganda, stadiondan ovoz to'lqini tarqaldi.
cards.uzDef: Birdan paydo bo'ladigan baland ovoz.

cards.ex: We could hear the dull roar of the ocean from our hotel room.
cards.exUz: Biz mehmonxona xonamizdan okeanning bo'g'iq g'uvillashini eshitdik.
cards.uzDef: Uzoqdan eshitiladigan past va doimiy g'uvillash.

cards.ex: His apology rang hollow after all the damage he'd caused.
cards.exUz: Uning uzri yetkazilgan zarardan keyin soxta tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Chinakam emasligi yoki ishonchsizligi sezilmoq.

cards.ex: If I won the lottery, I'd shout it from the rooftops!
cards.exUz: Agar lotereyada yutsam, hammaga jar solardim!
cards.uzDef: Hammaga baland ovozda e'lon qilmoq, maqtanish.
